paragraphs.en: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41 0.41 . For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型的最新进展使得视觉合成日益逼真。 然而，这些生成的环境在很大程度上仍然是无声的。 为世界模型引入声音带来了三个核心挑战：实时生成以与交互式视频流同步、交互式控制以响应流中出现的音频指令，以及空间对齐的立体声以反映场景几何和相机运动。 为满足这些需求，我们提出了 WorldSonus——一个交互式视频转音频框架，专为世界模型中的实时空间音频合成而设计。 为实现实时生成，WorldSonus 采用了一种流式因果自回归扩散架构，能以 0.41 的较低实时因子（RTF）合成音频片段。 在交互式控制方面，我们整合了一条以音频为核心的字幕生成流程，并采用片段索引化的提示调度机制，从而能够在生成过程中动态操控声音事件。 为实现空间对齐，我们利用从多样化立体声和环绕声数据中精心挑选的高品质立体声监督信号。 大量实验表明，尽管 WorldSonus 是为世界模型专门设计的，但它能有效推广到开放领域的视频转音频基准测试中，在音质和空间对齐方面与当前最先进的双向模型相当甚至更优。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Team, 2025b ) have accelerated the development of generative world models ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to world-model sound generation fall into two primary categories. The first direction builds upon joint audiovisual foundation models ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) extended to long-horizon streaming ( Duan et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Su et al., 2026 ) . However, coupling audio synthesis directly to the visual backbone prevents these systems from serving as standalone audio modules for visual-only world models, while causal distillation or long autoregressive (AR) rollouts often accumulate error over time. The second direction employs dedicated video-to-audio (V2A) generators, allowing modular integration with external visual engines. Yet current streaming V2A models remain constrained: V-AURA ( Viertola et al., 2025 ) uses bidirectional visual windows and outputs mono audio. SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) achieves real-time stereo generation but lacks mid-stream text controllability. SwanSphere ( Lei et al., 2026 ) focuses on panoramic video and first-order ambisonics (FOA) soundfields rather than standard perspective streams. Consequently, there remains a need for a modular V2A framework that simultaneously delivers causal real-time generation, mid-stream interactive text control, and spatially aligned perspective stereo audio.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的世界模型声音生成方法主要分为两大类。 第一类方法基于联合视听基础模型（HaCohen 等人，2026），并扩展至长时程流式处理（Duan 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026a；Su 等人，2026）。 然而，将音频合成直接与视觉主干模型耦合，使得这些系统无法作为纯视觉世界模型的独立音频模块；而因果蒸馏或长自回归（AR）展开则常会随时间累积误差。 第二类方法采用专用的视频到音频（V2A）生成器，从而实现与外部视觉引擎的模块化集成。 但当前的流式 V2A 模型仍存在限制：V-AURA（Viertola 等人，2025）使用双向视觉窗口，且仅输出单声道音频。 SoundReactor（Saito 等人，2025）虽能实现实时立体声生成，但缺乏流式处理过程中的文本控制能力。 SwanSphere（Lei 等人，2026）则专注于全景视频和一级环绕声（FOA）声场，而非标准的视角流数据。 因此，目前仍需要一个模块化的 V2A 框架，能够同时实现因果实时生成、流式过程中的交互式文本控制，以及空间对齐的视角立体声音频。

paragraphs.en: We present WorldSonus, a modular V2A framework designed to endow generative world models with real-time, controllable stereo audio. For real-time generation , WorldSonus employs a streaming AR-diffusion architecture emitting 100 100 ms audio chunks conditioned only on past and current visual context. A bounded persistent state ensures constant memory usage and compute cost as the stream expands. For interactive control , training on time-varying prompt schedules combined with chunk-level cross-attention enables users to dynamically revise text instructions for on-screen or off-screen sounds without session resets or past-frame recomputation. For spatially aligned stereo , we use clear-stereo clips and convert panoramic FOA data into camera-aligned stereo supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WorldSonus，这是一个模块化的 V2A 框架，旨在为生成式世界模型赋予实时、可控的立体声音频能力。 为了实现实时生成，WorldSonus 采用了一种流式 AR-diffusion 架构，仅基于过去和当前的视觉上下文，输出每段 100 毫秒的音频片段。 一种有界持久状态机制确保了随着数据流扩展，内存占用和计算成本保持恒定。 在交互控制方面，通过在时变提示调度上进行训练，并结合片段级的交叉注意力机制，用户无需重置会话或重新计算过往帧，即可动态修改对屏幕内或屏幕外声音的文本指令。 为实现空间对齐的立体声效果，我们使用清晰立体声片段，并将全景 FOA 数据转换为与摄像头对齐的立体声监督信号。

paragraphs.en: Generating precise audiovisual alignment within causal contexts introduces unique challenges, as future visual frames are unavailable. To enforce temporal synchronization under limited lookahead, we introduce two-timescale visual conditioning and ShiftNCE. Chunk-level visual summaries guide the AR backbone to maintain semantic continuity, while frame-aligned local tokens condition the flow head with fine-grained spatial and temporal cues. To refine event timing without inference cost, ShiftNCE trains the AR state using a contrastive objective supervised by a frozen synchronization expert, eliminating ambiguous temporal negatives during training.
paragraphs.zh: 在因果语境中生成精确的视听对齐会引入独特的挑战，因为未来的视觉帧并不可用。 为了在有限的前瞻能力下强制实现时间同步，我们引入了双时间尺度的视觉条件机制和 ShiftNCE。 块级视觉摘要引导 AR 主干模型保持语义连贯性，而帧对齐的局部标记则通过精细的空间和时间线索对流程头进行条件约束。 为了在不产生推理成本的情况下优化事件时间戳，ShiftNCE 使用一个对比目标训练 AR 状态，该目标由一个冻结的同步专家监督，从而在训练过程中消除模糊的时间负样本。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate that despite causal operation, WorldSonus matches or exceeds state-of-the-art offline bidirectional V2A baselines across both open-domain VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) videos and our Interactive benchmark, which comprises gameplay and real-world footage. WorldSonus achieves VGGish FAD ( Hershey et al., 2017 ; Kilgour et al., 2019 ) scores of 1.73 1.73 on 5 5 s clear-stereo VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) clips and 2.03 2.03 on 30 30 s interactive videos, with an execution latency of 41.2 41.2 ms per 100 100 ms audio chunk (real-time factor, RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ) on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，尽管 WorldSonus 采用因果式运行方式，但在开放领域的 VGGSound（Chen et al., 2020）视频以及包含游戏画面和真实世界视频的交互式基准测试中，其性能均与当前最先进的离线双向 V2A 基线模型相当或更优。 WorldSonus 在 5 秒清晰立体声的 VGGSound（Chen et al., 2020）片段上取得了 VGGish FAD（Hershey et al., 2017; Kilgour et al., 2019）评分为 1.73，在 30 秒交互式视频上的评分为 2.03；使用单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 时，其每 100 毫秒音频分片的执行延迟为 41.2 毫秒（实时因子，RTF = 0.41）。

sents.zh: 广泛的评估表明，与世界级双向离线基线模型相比，WorldSonus 在声学质量和立体声平衡方面具有竞争力或更优的表现，而反事实测试也证实了其稳健的交互控制能力。

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional video-to-audio (V2A) synthesis has evolved from text-to-audio latent diffusion models ( Liu et al., 2023a ) and early V2A diffusion networks ( Luo et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) to time-aligned models and rectified flow architectures ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ) , improving semantic and temporal fidelity through audio-visual pretraining and explicit synchronization features. Recent models such as AudioX ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , ThinkSound ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , and PrismAudio ( Liu et al., 2025b ) render stereo via flow matching and reward alignment. AC-Foley ( Fang et al., 2026 ) adds reference-audio conditioning, while Omni2Sound ( Dai et al., 2026 ) investigates video-text-to-audio diffusion across modality combinations. Meanwhile, spatial audio generation has advanced from diffusion-based binaural synthesis ( Leng et al., 2022 ) toward object-aware stereo and ambisonics ( Karchkhadze et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ) . However, these approaches require full-clip visual context and do not support streaming video input or dynamic control within a persistent causal session.
paragraphs.zh: 双向视频到音频（V2A）合成技术已从文本到音频的潜在扩散模型（Liu et al., 2023a）和早期的 V2A 扩散网络（Luo et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2026b），演进为时间对齐模型和修正流架构（Wang et al., 2024；Cheng et al., 2025），通过音频-视觉预训练和显式同步特征提升了语义与时间保真度。 近期的模型，如 AudioX（Tian et al., 2025）、ThinkSound（Liu et al., 2025a）和 PrismAudio（Liu et al., 2025b），通过流匹配和奖励对齐生成立体声。 AC-Foley（Fang et al., 2026）加入了参考音频条件约束，而 Omni2Sound（Dai et al., 2026）则研究了跨模态组合的视频-文本到音频扩散方法。 与此同时，空间音频生成已从基于扩散的双耳合成（Leng et al., 2022），发展为面向对象的立体声和环绕声技术（Karchkhadze et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2025c）。 然而，这些方法需要完整的视频片段上下文，且不支持流式视频输入或在持续因果会话中进行动态控制。

paragraphs.en: V-AURA ( Viertola et al., 2025 ) uses AR audio-token prediction with chunked waveform decoding, while SwanSphere ( Lei et al., 2026 ) extends causal generation to spatial audio conditioned on panoramic video and text. Neither establishes fully end-to-end causal streaming: V-AURA conditions each audio step on a bidirectional visual window and non-causal DAC ( Kumar et al., 2023 ) decoding, and SwanSphere’s variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ) , based on Stable Audio Open ( Evans et al., 2025 ) , does not support stateful stream decoding. SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) combines a causal AR backbone with a diffusion head for streaming audio from gameplay video. Its V2A generator weights are not public, so we adopt only the released causal VAE. Building on this line of work, we target open-domain, interactive video with bounded persistent state and sound instructions that can change mid-stream.

Trained with a causal sliding-window attention mask, the model deploys a fixed-capacity Ring-KV cache over context window W W (a circular buffer overwriting the oldest slots in place). This ensures bounded memory while matching the context-window policy between training and inference.

paragraphs.en: To reconcile long-horizon semantic continuity in the bounded AR backbone with precise acoustic rendering in the flow head, we decouple visual conditioning into two complementary timescales: chunk-level semantics and frame-aligned local features . For each chunk (spanning three frames), a frozen DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) encoder maps video frames into spatial patch grids 𝐆 n \mathbf{G}_{n} . Mixed-aspect inputs are assigned to resolution buckets and resized without stretching at a fixed pixel budget. To capture motion cues, each grid is concatenated with its temporal difference Δ ​ 𝐆 n = 𝐆 n − 𝐆 n − 1 \Delta\mathbf{G}_{n}=\mathbf{G}_{n}-\mathbf{G}_{n-1} ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . A learned query then aggregates each frame’s spatial grid into a single feature token, yielding three frame tokens per chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在有限的 AR 主干中实现长期语义连续性，同时确保流头部的精确声学渲染，我们将视觉条件约束解耦为两个互补的时间尺度：块级语义和帧对齐的局部特征。 对于每个块（涵盖三帧），一个冻结的 DINOv3（Siméoni et al., 2026）编码器将视频帧映射为空间分块网格 𝐆 n \mathbf{G}_{n}。 混合宽高比的输入被分配到不同分辨率的桶中，并在固定的像素预算下以不拉伸的方式调整大小。 为了捕捉运动线索，每个网格都与它的时域差异 Δ ​ 𝐆 n = 𝐆 n − 𝐆 n − 1 \Delta\mathbf{G}_{n}=\mathbf{G}_{n}-\mathbf{G}_{n-1}（Chen et al., 2026）进行拼接。 随后，一个可学习的查询将每帧的空间网格聚合为单个特征令牌，从而每个块生成三个帧令牌。

paragraphs.en: To support interactive control during streaming, we introduce an in-place prompt control mechanism that allows text instructions to be updated mid-stream.
paragraphs.zh: 为支持流式传输过程中的交互式控制，我们引入了一种原地提示控制机制，该机制允许在流式传输过程中更新文本指令。

paragraphs.en: Given a sound instruction, a T5Gemma 2 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) text encoder and compressor project it into a compact token set that conditions the AR backbone via cross-attention, which is cached across streaming steps. When an instruction updates during streaming, the system performs an in-place replacement of the cross-attention cache at the nearest chunk boundary, preserving the Ring-KV cache and existing visual and audio states. To train the model for these dynamic transitions, we incorporate time-varying prompt schedules including mid-sequence instruction switches and drops. This enables seamless steering in a persistent causal session.

paragraphs.en: Our dataset contains 1,465 1{,}465 hours of audio, including 999 999 hours of paired stereo video-audio data and 466 466 hours of audio-only data. The video-audio subset uses open-source datasets including VGGSound ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , AudioSet ( Gemmeke et al., 2017 ) , Kinetics-700 ( Carreira et al., 2019 ) , and HD-EPIC ( Perrett et al., 2025 ) to cover a wide range of acoustic events. To support audio generation for interactive world models, we collect additional standard stereo video with clear camera motion and dynamic objects. We also incorporate panoramic recordings from the existing Sphere360 ( Liu et al., 2025c ) and YT-AmbiGen ( Kim et al., 2025 ) datasets. For panoramic clips, we estimate horizontal sound directions from the acoustic energy field to sample perspective visual crops and render view-aligned stereo audio. The audio-only subset includes AudioCaps ( Kim et al., 2019 ) and isolated audio tracks from weakly-aligned video clips, where the visual content is not aligned with the audio, but the soundtrack retains high-quality acoustic events.

paragraphs.en: For acoustic fidelity , we report Fréchet distances in VGGish ( Hershey et al., 2017 ) (FAD ( Kilgour et al., 2019 ) ), PaSST ( Koutini et al., 2022 ) (FD P ), and OpenL3 ( Cramer et al., 2019 ) (FD O ) feature spaces, together with PaSST-based KL divergence (KL P ). FAD and FD O use the mid-channel signal. S-FD O applies the OpenL3 distance to the side-channel signal to evaluate stereo distribution quality. For audiovisual alignment , we use ImageBind ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ) (IB) similarity for semantic consistency and Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) offset (DeSync) for synchronization, supplemented by onset accuracy, F1, and AP on Greatest Hits following MMAudio ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We conduct quantitative comparisons across all five held-out test splits. As shown in Table 1 , WorldSonus achieves competitive or superior acoustic quality (FAD, FD P , and KL P ) compared to bidirectional models on both VGGSound and interactive video datasets, despite using only visual frames from past and current chunks. Compared with the streaming baseline V-AURA, WorldSonus achieves lower distributional divergence and stronger audiovisual alignment while running at a much finer temporal resolution ( 100 100 ms vs. 640 640 ms), synthesized in just 41.2 41.2 ms per chunk on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU ( RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ) to comfortably satisfy real-time streaming requirements. Together, these results demonstrate that bounded-memory causal generation can combine competitive audio quality with real-time synthesis across the evaluated 5 5 – 30 30 s durations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对所有五个预留的测试分集进行了定量比较。 如表 1 所示，尽管 WorldSonus 仅使用过去和当前片段中的视觉帧，但在 VGGSound 和交互式视频数据集上，其声学质量（FAD、FD P 和 KL P）与双向模型相比具有竞争力或更优。 与流式基线模型 V-AURA 相比，WorldSonus 在以更精细的时间分辨率（100 100 毫秒 vs. 640 640 毫秒）运行的同时，实现了更低的分布差异和更强的视听对齐；它仅需 41.2 41.2 毫秒/片段即可在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上完成合成（RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41），从而轻松满足实时流式传输的要求。 综合来看，这些结果表明，有限内存的因果生成方法能够在所评估的 5 5 – 30 30 秒时长的范围内，同时实现具有竞争力的音频质量和实时合成。

paragraphs.en: To analyze potential drift during continuous streaming, we evaluate 1,024 1{,}024 Interactive 30 30 s clips under two regimes: Direct (generating the final 25 25 – 30 30 s window from a cold start) and Rollout tail (extracting the final window from an uninterrupted 30 30 s stream). It indicates that under our bounded 5 5 s Ring-KV cache, WorldSonus maintains stable, collapse-free streaming across extended horizons without periodic resets.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate interactive prompt control, we measure text to audio agreement using CLAP ( Wu et al., 2023 ) between each 5 5 s audio segment and its caption. For 10 10 s clips, let P 1 P_{1} and P 2 P_{2} denote the sequential instructions for the first and second 5 5 s halves ( P 1 → P 2 P_{1}\to P_{2} ). We report the dual relative match rate, defined as the percentage of clips where both 5 5 s segments score higher with their own caption than with the other. As shown in Table 6 , WorldSonus achieves dual match rates of 25.68 % 25.68\% on VGGSound and 23.44 % 23.44\% on Interactive 10 10 s, outperforming all baseline architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估交互式提示控制，我们使用 CLAP（Wu 等人，2023）测量每个 5 秒音频片段与其字幕之间的文本与音频一致性。 对于 10 秒的片段，令 P₁ 和 P₂ 分别表示前 5 秒和后 5 秒的连续指令（P₁ → P₂）。 我们报告双重相对匹配率，定义为那些两个 5 秒片段都与其自身字幕的匹配得分高于与另一段字幕匹配得分的片段所占的百分比。 如表 6 所示，WorldSonus 在 VGGSound 上的双重匹配率为 25.68%，在 Interactive 10 秒数据集上的双重匹配率为 23.44%，优于所有基线架构。

paragraphs.en: Temporal alignment objective. To investigate whether the proposed ShiftNCE objective explicitly drives fine-grained synchronization, and whether external temporal representations can replace it, we compare our default model against a variant trained without ShiftNCE and another incorporating direct features from a 640 640 ms causal Synchformer ( Iashin et al., 2024 ) window. As shown in Table 7 , removing ShiftNCE degrades DeSync from 0.831 0.831 to 1.067 1.067 , while direct feature injection yields worse timing and acoustic quality, possibly reflecting a mismatch between its 640 640 ms feature window and our 100 100 ms streaming chunks. These results confirm that ShiftNCE provides the necessary temporal supervision to sharpen alignment without requiring additional sync encoders or inference overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 时间对齐目标。 为了探究所提出的 ShiftNCE 目标是否明确推动了精细同步，以及外部时间表示是否可以替代它，我们将默认模型与一个未使用 ShiftNCE 训练的变体模型，以及另一个融合了来自 640 ms 因果 Synchformer（Iashin 等，2024）窗口的直接特征模型进行了比较。 如表 7 所示，移除 ShiftNCE 会使 DeSync 性能从 0.831 下降至 1.067，而直接注入特征则导致了更差的时间同步和声学质量，这或许反映了其 640 ms 的特征窗口与我们 100 ms 的流式处理片段之间存在不匹配。 这些结果证实，ShiftNCE 提供了必要的时间监督，能够在无需额外同步编码器或推理开销的情况下提升对齐精度。

paragraphs.en: We present WorldSonus, a causal spatial audio synthesis framework for real-time sound generation in interactive world models. By factorizing generation into chunk-wise autoregressive flow matching, WorldSonus synthesizes 48 48 kHz stereo audio in 100 100 ms chunks with an execution latency of 41.2 41.2 ms per chunk on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU ( RTF = 0.41 \mathrm{RTF}=0.41 ). Our decoupled visual conditioning couples long-term planning via a bounded 5 5 s Ring-KV cache with frame-aligned local guidance in the flow head, while training-only ShiftNCE enforces precise temporal synchronization with zero inference overhead. Evaluated on open-domain videos and interactive environments, WorldSonus achieves acoustic fidelity and spatial localization competitive with or exceeding offline bidirectional models, while seamlessly supporting real-time prompt updates.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WorldSonus，这是一个用于交互式世界模型中实时声音生成的因果空间音频合成框架。 通过将生成过程分解为分块自回归流匹配，WorldSonus 能够以每块 41.2 毫秒的执行延迟（单 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上），在 100 毫秒的块内合成 48 kHz 的立体声音频（RTF = 0.41）。 我们的解耦视觉条件机制通过一个最大容量为 5 秒的 Ring-KV 缓存实现长期规划，并在流头中结合帧对齐的局部引导；而仅用于训练的 ShiftNCE 则能在不增加推理开销的情况下确保精确的时间同步。 在开放域视频和交互式环境中的评估表明，WorldSonus 在声学保真度和空间定位方面达到了与离线双向模型相当甚至更优的水平，同时能够无缝支持实时提示更新。

SoundReactor ( Saito et al., 2025 ) reports lower reconstruction quality for its causal VAE decoder than for its non-causal counterpart. Developing more expressive, large-scale causal audio codecs will be crucial to close this performance gap in future work.

paragraphs.en: High-quality spatial audio data remains scarce compared to massive monophonic corpora. Many public stereo videos contain artificial or noisy channel separation that does not accurately reflect visual object motion. While our two-stage filtering pipeline and panoramic soundfield decoding extract reliable spatial supervision, expanding the scale of authentic stereo data remains a key goal for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 与庞大的单声道语料库相比，高质量的空间音频数据仍然十分稀缺。 许多公开的立体声视频包含人工处理或充满噪声的声道分离效果，无法准确反映视觉物体的运动。 尽管我们的两阶段过滤流程与全景声场解码能够提取可靠的空间监督信息，但扩大真实立体声数据的规模仍然是未来工作的关键目标。

paragraphs.en: For fair comparison, AudioX ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , ThinkSound ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , and PrismAudio ( Liu et al., 2025b ) receive identical audio-centric captions as WorldSonus and are executed via their official inference pipelines with chain-of-thought reasoning disabled. paragraphs.en: To facilitate mid-stream steering during continuous generation sessions, each 10-s paired training sequence is assigned one of four prompt schedules:

paragraphs.en: Mid-stream switch ( 60 % 60\% ) : Prompt P 1 P_{1} conditions the first 5-s segment, switching to prompt P 2 P_{2} at the 5-s boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 中途切换（60% 60\%）：提示 P₁ P_{1} 对前 5 秒的片段进行条件设定，并在 5 秒处切换至提示 P₂ P_{2}。

paragraphs.en: Instruction withdrawal ( 10 % 10\% ) : Prompt P 1 P_{1} conditions the first 5-s segment, followed by generation without text conditioning ( P = ∅ P=\emptyset ) for the second 5 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 指令撤回（10% 10\%）：提示 P₁ P_{1} 对前 5 秒的片段进行条件设定，随后在第二 5 秒内生成内容时不再进行文本条件设定（P = ∅ P=\emptyset）。

paragraphs.en: Instruction arrival ( 10 % 10\% ) : Generation begins without text conditioning ( P = ∅ P=\emptyset ) for the first 5 seconds, followed by prompt P 1 P_{1} for the remaining 5 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 指令到达（10% 10\%）：前 5 秒内开始生成时没有文本条件约束（P = ∅ P=\emptyset），随后在接下来的 5 秒内使用提示 P₁ P_{1}。

paragraphs.en: Sustained hold ( 20 % 20\% ) : Prompt P 1 P_{1} is maintained continuously across the full 10-s sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 持续保持（20% 20\%）：提示 P₁ P_{1} 在整个 10 秒序列中持续保持。

paragraphs.en: Channel energy and DC centering : Audio is resampled to 48 48 kHz and DC-centered per channel. Any clip exhibiting root-mean-square energy RMS < 10 − 4 \mathrm{RMS}<10^{-4} on either channel is discarded as silent.
paragraphs.zh: 通道能量与直流中心化：音频被重采样至 48 kHz，并对每个通道进行直流中心化。 任何在任一通道上均方根能量 RMS < 10⁻⁴ 的片段都将被视为静音并丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Baselines fall into three temporal access modes:
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法可分为三种时间访问模式：

paragraphs.en: Bidirectional access (AudioX, ThinkSound, PrismAudio) : These models require full-clip visual context prior to inference. They process video frames via full-sequence bidirectional attention, rendering them unsuitable for streaming or live-deployment scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 双向访问（AudioX、ThinkSound、PrismAudio）：这些模型在推理前需要完整的视频片段视觉上下文。 它们通过全序列双向注意力处理视频帧，因此不适合流式传输或实时部署场景。

paragraphs.en: Stream mode (V-AURA) : For long-form generation, V-AURA operates with 640 640 ms strides over a 2.56 2.56 s visual window. Within this localized window, frame encoding via TimeSformer ( Bertasius et al., 2021 ) remains non-causal, and DAC ( Kumar et al., 2023 ) neural decoding incorporates future context.
paragraphs.zh: 流式模式（V-AURA）：对于长文本生成，V-AURA 以 640 毫秒的步长在 2.56 秒的视觉窗口内运行。 在此局部化窗口内，通过 TimeSformer（Bertasius 等人，2021）进行的帧编码仍然是非因果的，而 DAC（Kumar 等人，2023）神经解码则包含了未来上下文信息。
